theorems.name: Submission.ltg_glue_triples
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), (∀ (A A' : Set (Eucl P)) (ϑ ϑ' : Eucl P → ℝ) (x : Eucl P) (W : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen W → x ∈ W → (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)) (symmDiff A A' ∩ W) = 0 → (∀ᵐ y ∂((μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict (A ∩ W)), ϑ y = ϑ' y) → ϑ x = ϑ' x → ∀ L : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k A ϑ x L → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k A' ϑ' x L) → ∀ (V M : ℕ → Set (Eucl P)) (θ : ℕ → Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : ℕ → Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) k), (∀ i, IsOpen (V i)) → U ⊆ ⋃ i, V i → (∀ i, IsRectifiableTriple U k (M i) (θ i) (ξ i)) → (∀ i, ∀ x ∈ M i, ∃ n : ℕ, θ i x = n) → (∀ i j, (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)) (symmDiff (M i) (M j) ∩ (V i ∩ V j)) = 0 ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict (M i ∩ (V i ∩ V j))), θ i x = θ j x ∧ ξ i x = ξ j x) → ∃ (M₀ : Set (Eucl P)) (θ₀ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ₀ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) k), IsRectifiableTriple U k M₀ θ₀ ξ₀ ∧ (∀ x ∈ M₀, ∃ n : ℕ, θ₀ x = n) ∧ ∀ i, (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)) (symmDiff (M i) M₀ ∩ V i) = 0 ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict (M i ∩ V i)), θ i x = θ₀ x ∧ ξ i x = ξ₀ x
